title: Planar half-density percolation has no unique infinite cluster
exact_target: Does almost-sure site percolation at probability one half on a planar graph force infinitely many infinite open clusters?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000087 (AMR-099-0087). CC BY 4.0.

I. Benjamini and O. Schramm, \emph{Percolation beyond $\mathbb Z^d$, many questions and a few answers}, Electronic Communications in Probability 1 (1996), pp. 71--82, Conjecture 8, p. 80, with the conventions of Section 2.
